Here's the thought. It's wobbly but just might hold up.

I'm not trying to break voting systems or anything like that. Instead, PUPing something would make a very small change to the CSS of a post title or comment background, which would only exist for, say, one hour or one day after the PUP was given. So a contribution to the site becomes a tiny bit more prominent as a result of a trusted/quality user giving it a rare extra level of "up"ness.

What would the details of this idea be?

  • You can earn ONE powerUP, which is a special magical upvote
  • You earn it only by making popular posts
  • A limited number of PUPs are ever earnt - not "one for each post with >1000 points" but "The top posters, judged across multiple submissions/comments, until x amount have been given out in one [week/month/whatever]"
  • One you have a PUP you can use it now, or keep it until you think it should be used
  • You can't start earning your next one until after the first one is used
  • (Maybe) A PUPed post can't receive another one - OR - multiple PUPs on one post give exponentially smaller extensions to the time it stays enhanced (1 day / 12h / 6 / 3 / etc.) with no way to check if you are giving 12h or 22.5 mins. So if you weren't the first to do so, you'd use your PUP because you meant it, not because you could quantify the impact.

How would it affect things?

The effects would be:

  • Subtle - no impact on post/comment ordering
  • Cosmetic - you could spot it when scrolling or ignore it
  • Time limited / soon removed - No way for a post to stay highlighted for more than 2 continuous days

How would it be used?

After voting something "up", a user with a PUP could re-click the "up" to grant the extra magical approval.

There's a high chance this is a terrible idea, I'm really not sure either way. I haven't got any suggestions for how (or if) you would be notified when someone powerUPs one of your things, or how you would be able to tell that you had earned one ready for use.

But in my mind it's all fantastic, like a utopia where those extra prominent eBay listings aren't highlighted because the seller paid more, but are highlighted because they are actually good!

Won't this just encourage top posters to form little cliques that ensure their posts remain at the top? eg. "Let's all power up each others' posts so they get more visibility, thereby earning more votes in general, thereby ensuring we get more power ups"
